articles.heading: Icyo aya mabwiriza rusange agamije Aya mabwiriza rusange ashyiraho ibisabwa byerekeye imiyoborere, inshingano mu
articles.text:
mbonerahamwe y’imiterere y’inzego
z’imirimo by’ibigo by’imari iciriritse byakira
amafaranga abitswa kandi agashimangira
uburyo bwo gucunga ibyateza ingorane
biturutse ku miyoborere.

articles.heading: Isobanura Muri aya mabwiriza rusange
articles.text:
(a) “Banki Nkuru” bivuga Banki Nkuru
y’u Rwanda, urwego rw’ubugenzuzi;
(b) « ikigo cy’imari iciriritse cyakira
amafaranga abitswa » bivuga ikigo
cy’imari iciriritse cyakira amafaranga
y’abaturage cyangwa
ay’abanyamuryango bacyo;
(c) « isosiyete y’imari iciriritse yakira
amafaranga abitswa » bivuga isosiyete
ifite uburyozwe bugarukira ku
migabane, yemerewe gukora imirimo
yo kwakira amafaranga abitswa no
gutanga inguzanyo;
(d) « koperative y’imari iciriritse yakira
amafaranga abitswa» bivuga
koperative yemerewe gukora nka
koperative yo kuzigama no kuguriza;
(e) «abagize ubuyobozi» bivuga abakozi
bari mu buyobozi bukuru bari ku rwego
rwo hejuru cyangwa abakozi b’ingenzi
b’ikigo cy’imari iciriritse cyakira
amafaranga abitswa, harimo –
(i) Umuyobozi mukuru;
(ii) Abakozi bo mu buyobozi
bukuru batanga raporo ku
nama y’ubutegetsi cyangwa
ku makomite y’inama
y’ubutegetsi; na
(iii) Abakozi bo mu buyobozi
bukuru batanga raporo ku
muyobozi mukuru.
(f) “umunyamuryango” bivuga umuntu ku
giti cye cyangwa ikigo gifite
ubuzimagatozi bigize koperative
y’imari iciriritse yakira amafaranga
abitswa, amakoperative y’imari
iciriritse yakira amafaranga abitswa
agize ihuriro cyangwa amahuriro agize
impuzamahuriro;
(g) “kugira imigabane igaragara” bivuga
imigabane umuntu afite mu kigo
cy’imari iciriritse cyakira amafaranga
abitswa ku buryo butaziguye cyangwa
buziguye, ari wenyine cyangwa ari
kumwe n’abandi ihwanye nibura na
gatanu ku ijana y’imari shingiro yacyo
cyangwa by’uburenganzira bwo gutora
cyangwa imuhesha ububasha bwo
kugira uruhare mu ifatwa ry’ibyemezo
mu micungire y’icyo kigo;
(h) “uruhare rugaragara” bivuga ububasha
bwo kugira uruhare mu gufata
ibyemezo ku mikorere na politiki
byerekeranye n’imari y’ikigo cy’imari
iciriritse cyakira amafaranga abitswa;
(i) “umuntu ufitanye isano n’ikigo”
hakubiyemo, bitabangamiye
ibiteganywa n’itegeko rigenga ibigo
by’imari iciriritse byakira amafaranga
abitswa:
(i) muri sosiyete y’imari iciriritse
yakira amafaranga abitswa:
umunyamigabane ufite
imigabane igaragara, ugize
inama y’ubutegetsi, uri mu
buyobozi, umukozi ndetse
n’uwo bashakanye, uwo
bafitanye isano itaziguye
cyangwa iziguye kugeza ku
gisanira cya kabiri;
(ii) muri koperative y’imari
iciriritse yakira amafaranga
abitswa: ugize inama
y’ubutegetsi, ugize komite
zatowe, uri mu buyobozi,
umukozi ndetse n’uwo
bashakanye, uwo bafitanye
isano itaziguye cyangwa
iziguye kugeza ku gisanira cya
kabiri.
(j) “uri mu nama y’ubutegetsi
nshingwabikorwa” bivuga umwe mu
bagize inama y’ubutegetsi unafite
inshingano z’ubuyobozi mu kigo
cy’imari iciriritse cyakira amafaranga
abitswa;
(k) “uri mu nama y’ubutegetsi utari
nshingwabikorwa” bivuga umwe mu
bagize inama y’ubutegetsi ariko udafite
inshingano z’ubuyobozi mu kigo
cy’imari iciriritse cyakira amafaranga
abitswa;
(l) “uri mu nama y’ubutegetsi wigenga”
bivuga umwe mu bagize inama
y’ubutegetsi utari nshingwabikorwa
kandi utari umunyamuryango cyangwa
umunyamigabane kandi udafite
inshingano z’ubuyobozi mu kigo
cy’imari iciriritse cyakira amafaranga
abitswa kandi utashyirwaho igitutu
kubera impamvu zaturuka imbere mu
kigo, hanze yacyo, ari izishingiye kuri
politiki cyangwa umutungo ku buryo
byatuma atubahiriza inshingano ze mu
bwigenge.
UMUTWE WA II: IMIYOBORERE
Icyiciro cya mbere: Ingingo zihariye ku
masosiyete y’imari iciriritse yakira
amafaranga abitswa

articles.heading: Ishyirwaho rya perezida w’inama y’ubutegetsi (1) Nta munyamigabane ufite imigabane igaragara ushobora kuba perezida
articles.text:
w’inama y’ubutegetsi kandi abujijwe
kuba umwe mu bagize ubuyobozi.
(2) Inshingano za perezida w’inama
y’ubutegetsi zigomba gutandukanywa
n’iz’umuyobozi mukuru ku buryo nta
muntu ku giti cye ugira ububasha
butabangamirwa bwo gufata ibyemezo
mu gihe akomatanyije iyo myanya ibiri
mu gihe kimwe.
(3) Imyanya ya perezida w’inama
y’ubutegetsi, iy’umuyobozi mukuru
cyangwa iy’uri mu nama y’ubutegetsi
nshingwabikorwa ntigomba
gukomatanywa n’umuntu umwe
cyangwa kugibwamo n’abantu babiri
bafitanye isano itaziguye cyangwa
iziguye kugeza ku gisanira cya kabiri.
(4) Perezida w’inama y’ubutegetsi nta
yindi komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi
ayobora.

articles.heading: Abagize inama y’ubutegetsi, manda n’inama zayo (1) Inama y’ubutegetsi iba igizwe nibura n’abantu batanu, muri bo nibura batatu
articles.text:
bagomba kuba ari abari mu nama
y’ubutegetsi bigenga.
(2) Mu gihe sosiyete y’imari iciriritse
yakira amafaranga abitswa ishatse
kugira abari mu nama y’ubutegetsi
barenze batanu, igipimo cya 3/5
cy’abari mu nama y’ubutegetsi bigenga
kigomba guhora cyubahirizwa.
(3) Abagize inama y’ubutegetsi bagira
manda y’imyaka itatu ishobora
kongerwa kabiri.
(4) Manda z’abari mu nama y’ubutegetsi
zigomba kujyana no kwita ku
gukomeza kw’ibikorwa by’ikigo nta
guhagarara.
(5) Abagize inama y’ubutegetsi
bahagarariye isosiyete mbyeyi mu
nama y’ubutegetsi ya sosiyete yabyawe
na yo ntibagomba kurenga kimwe cya
gatatu cy’umubare wose w’abagize
inama y’ubutegetsi mu rwego rwo
kubungabunga ubwigenge bwa
sosiyete yabyawe na yo.
(6) Inama y’ubutegetsi igomba guterana
buri gihembwe cyangwa ikindi gihe
cyose bibaye ngombwa.
(7) Ntawe mu bagize inama y’ubutegetsi
nyuma yo gukora manda eshatu (3)
zikurikirana wemerewe gutorwa
kugeza hashize imyaka itanu.

articles.heading: Ubumenyi busabwa abagize inama y’ubutegetsi Inama y’ubutegetsi igomba kuba ifite uburambe n’ubumenyi butandukanye harimo
articles.text:
amasomo ajyanye n’ubucuruzi, amategeko,
ikoranabuhanga, imari n’icunga mutungo,
ubushakashatsi n’ubundi bumenyi bitewe
n’ingano n’urwego bya sosiyete y’imari
iciriritse yakira amafaranga abitswa.

articles.heading: Isuzumamikorere rikorerwa inama y’ubutegetsi (1) Inama y’ubutegetsi isuzuma buri gihe ubumenyi ifite bwuzuzanya ndetse
articles.text:
n’uburambe n’ubundi bumenyi kugira
ngo hakorwe isesengura ryo kureba
niba inama y’ubutegetsi ikora neza
kandi abayigize bakwiriye imirimo
barimo.
(2) Iryo suzuma rikorwa n’abagize inama
y’ubutegetsi buri wese asuzuma
mugenzi we kandi n’inama
y’ubutegetsi yisuzuma muri rusange,
cyangwa isuzuma komite zayo
n’uruhare rwa buri wese mu bayigize,
na perezida wayo arimo, hifashishijwe
urupapuro rwabugenewe ruri mu
mugereka wa 1 w’aya mabwiriza
rusange.
(3) Isuzuma rikorwa buri mwaka kandi
raporo y’umwaka ikagaragaza ko
byakozwe. Bitarenze itariki ya 30 Mata
y’umwaka ukurikira, perezida w’inama
y’ubutegetsi ashyikiriza Banki Nkuru
raporo irimo ibyavuye mu isuzuma
buri muyobozi yakoreye mugenzi we
n’iryo inama y’ubutegetsi yikoreye
buri mwaka ku mikorere n’umusaruro
by’inama y’ubutegetsi n’abayigize.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’inama y’ubutegetsi Inama y’ubutegetsi ifite inshingano zirimo izikurikira
Komite z’inama y’ubutegetsi (1) Inama y’ubutegetsi ya sosiyete y’imari iciriritse yakira amafaranga abitswa
articles.text:
igomba kugira nibura komite
zikurikira:
(a) Komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi
ishinzwe ubugenzuzi;
(b) Komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi
ishinzwe inguzanyo;
(c) Komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi
ishinzwe gucunga ibyateza
ingorane;
(d) Indi komite y’inama
y’ubutegetsi yagenwa na
politiki n’amabwiriza
bikurikizwa mu kigo.
(2) Ibikorwa birebana no gushyira abakozi
mu myanya n’imishahara byigwa
n’inama y’ubutegetsi na ho ibikorwa
A
birebana n’ikoranabuhanga no
gukurikiza amategeko byigwa na
komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
gucunga ibyateza ingorane.

articles.heading: Abagize komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe ubugenzuzi n’ubumenyi bwabo (1) Komite. y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
articles.text:
ubugenzuzi iba igizwe n’abantu batatu;
perezida wayo agomba kuba ari uri mu
nama y’ubutegetsi wigenga abandi
babiri ari abari mu nama y’ubutegetsi
batari nshingwabikorwa.
(2) Nibura babiri mu bagize komite
y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
ubugenzuzi bagomba kuba bafite
nibura impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro
cya mbere cya kaminuza mu imari,
ibaruramari n’ibindi bifitanye isano
bakaba kandi bafite uburambe mu
byerekeye imirimo y’amabanki.

articles.heading: Inshingano za komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe ubugenzuzi Komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
articles.text:
ubugenzuzi ifite inshingano z’ibanze
zikurikira:
(a) kugenzura ko inyandiko z’imari
zateguriwe igihe kandi mu buryo
bunoze;
(b) gusuzuma ubugenzuzi bw’imbere mu
kigo harimo ibigize gahunda
y’ubugenzuzi bw’imbere, ibyo
ubugenzuzi bw’imbere bwabashije
kubona no gutanga inama zafatwa
n’ubuyobozi bw’ikigo;
(c) kugenzura ukuri kw’inyandiko
z’ibaruramari za sosiyete y’imari
iciriritse yakira mafaranga abitswa;
(d) kugenzura gahunda y’itangwa
ry’inguzanyo;
(e) kugenzura ibikorwa by’inama
y’ubutegetsi, ndetse n’iby’andi
makomite harimo komite y’inama
y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe inguzanyo,
komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
gucunga ibyateza ingorane n’izindi;
(f) kugenzura imirimo y’ubuyobozi;
(g) gukurikirana ko hubahirizwa
amategeko n’amabwiriza rusange;
(h) gukurikirana ishyira mu bikorwa
ry’ibyemezo by’inama z’inteko
rusange y’abanyamigabane,
iz’umugenzuzi w’imbere mu kigo
n’uwigenga, iza komite y’ubugenzuzi
y’inama y’ubutegetsi ubwayo, Banki
Nkuru n’abandi;
(i) gukurikirana ishyira mu bikorwa
ry’igenamigambi n’ingengo y’imari;
(j) gusuzuma raporo z’ubugenzuzi
bw’imbere mu kigo n’umusaruro
wazo, icyo zibugaho n’ubucukumbure
bwazo, raporo ku bugenzuzi
bw’imbere n’inama zikubiyemo no
kwemeza niba harakozwe ibikwiriye;
(k) gusuzuma niba hari imikoranire hagati
y’ubugenzuzi bw’imbere mu kigo
n’abagenzuzi bigenga;
(l) gushyikiriza inama y’ubutegetsi
cyangwa abanyamigabane, kugira ngo
bemeze ishyirwaho, ibihembo
n’iyirukanwa ry’abagenzuzi bigenga;
(m)gukurikirana no gusesengura
ubwisanzure bw’abagenzuzi bigenga,
nibura buri mwaka, hitabwa ku
bisabwa n’umwuga bakora ndetse
n’amabwiriza abagenga;
(n) gusuzuma hamwe n’abagenzuzi
bigenga ibirebwa na gahunda
y’ubugenzuzi yabo, uburyo raporo
z’ubugenzuzi bw’imbere zikorwamo,
ubufasha bwatanzwe n’ubuyobozi
n’abakozi ku bagenzuzi
n’ibyabuvuyemo n’ingamba zikwiriye
gufatwa;
(o) gusuzuma raporo z’ubuyobozi
n’iz’abagenzuzi bigenga cyane cyane
izerekeye ibinyuranyo n’imikorere
itanoze mu ibaruramari n’ubugenzuzi
bw’imikorere;
(p) gusuzuma gahunda y’ubugenzuzi
y’ikigo hagendewe by’umwihariko ku
mabwiriza yerekana ingorane zaturuka
ku kutubahiriza amategeko no
gukumira ingaruka byatera ikigo,
harimo gusuzuma inyandiko z’inzego
z’ubugenzuzi n’ibisubizo ubuyobozi
bwatanze;
(q) kwiga ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose
cyagaragajwe mu nama za komite
y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
gucunga ibyateza ingorane;
(r) gukurikirana imyitwarire myiza
y’ikigo no kwiga uburyo yatezwa
imbere, harimo imikoreshereze myiza
y’amabwiriza mu gukemura no
kumenyekanisha ibirego byatanzwe;
(s) gusuzuma ibikorwa byose
by’ubucuruzi n’abantu bafitanye isano
na sosiyete y’imari iciriritse yakira
amafaranga abitswa.

articles.heading: Abagize komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe inguzanyo n’ubumenyi bwabo (1) Komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
articles.text:
inguzanyo igomba kuba igizwe
n’abagize inama y’ubutegetsi batatu;
babiri ari abari mu nama y’ubutegetsi
batari nshingwabikorwa.
(2) Nibura umwe mu bagize komite
y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
inguzanyo utari nshingwabikorwa
agomba kuba afite nibura
impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya mbere
cya kaminuza mu imari, ibaruramari
cyangwa ibindi bifitanye isano kandi
akagira uburambe mu byerekeye
imirimo y’amabanki.

articles.heading: Inshingano za komite ishinzwe inguzanyo Inshingano z’ingenzi za komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe inguzanyo ifite
articles.text:
inshingano z’ibanze zikurikira:
(a) gusuzuma no kugenzura politiki
y’inguzanyo ya sosiyete y’imari
iciriritse yakira amafaranga abitswa;
(b) gusuzuma no gufata imyanzuro kuri
dosiye zisaba inguzanyo ziri mu
bushishozi bwayo bwo kwemeza;
(c) kugenzura ko hari uburyo bukora neza
ndetse n’amikoro byo gutahura no
gucungana n’ibibazo by’inguzanyo
zitishyurirwa igihe, kugabanya ku
buryo bwose bushoboka igihombo
gituruka ku nguzanyo no kugaruza
imyenda yose yatanzwe;
(d) kuyobora, gukurikirana, gusuzuma no
kwita ku bibazo byose bishobora
kugira ingaruka zikomeye ku mikorere
myiza isanzwe iranga ikigo
n’izakiranga ku bigendanye no
gucunga ingorane zituruka ku
nguzanyo;
(e) gusuzuma ingano y’inguzanyo
ntarengwa no guha ububasha inzego
zitandukanye z’ikigo bwo kwemeza
inguzanyo;
(f) kunganira inama y’ubutegetsi mu
kurangiza inshingano zayo zo
gusuzuma imiterere y’inguzanyo no
kugenzura ko inguzanyo zakorewe
iteganyirizagihombo rihagiije
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’ingingo
z’amabwiriza rusange yerekeye
gushyira inguzanyo mu byiciro no
guteganyiriza igihombo;
(g) kugenzura ko politiki y’inguzanyo
n’inguzanyo ntarengwa bivugururwa
hakurikijwe n’uko imiterere y’isoko
imeze;
(h) gusohoza indi nshingano yose ikubiye
muri politiki n’amabwiriza by’ikigo.

articles.heading: Abagize komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe gucunga ibyateza ingorane n’ubumenyi zabo (1) Komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
articles.text:
gucunga ibyateza ingorane igizwe
n’abantu batatu; perezida agomba kuba
ari uri mu nama y’ubutegetsi wigenga
naho abandi babiri ari abari mu nama
y’ubutegetsi batari nshingwabikorwa.
(2) Nibura umwe mu bagize komite
y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
gucunga ibyateza ingorane agomba
kuba afite nibura impamyabumenyi
y’icyiciro cya mbere cya kaminuza mu
imari, ibaruramari cyangwa ibindi
bifitanye isano kandi akagira uburambe
mu byerekeye imirimo y’amabanki.

articles.heading: Inshingano za komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe gucunga ibyateza ingorane Komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
articles.text:
gucunga ibyateza ingorane ifite inshingano
z’ibanze zikurikira:
(a) gushyiraho no gusuzuma gahunda yo
gucunga ibyatera ingorane;
(b) gusesengura ibipimo by’ingorane
zitandukanye za sosiyete y’imari
iciriritse yakira amafaranga abitswa,
ingaruka zazo, ubukana bwazo n’igihe
zishobora kubaho;
(c) gusesengura igipimo cy’uburyo
sosiyete y’imari iciriritse yakira
amafaranga abitswa yubahiriza
amategeko n’amabwiriza ndetse na
politiki n’amabwiriza byayo no
gutanga inama ku ngamba zikwiriye
gufatwa;
(d) gusesengura ibipimo by’umutungo
n’imyenda hamwe n’ibipimo
by’imikorere hagatangwa inama
zikwiriye zijyanye n’imikorere
ikwiriye;
(e) gushyiraho ingamba zikwiriye
zigenewe sosiyete y’imari iciriritse
yakira amafaranga abitswa mu
byerekeye ivangwa ry’umutungo
n’imyenda hashingiwe ku byo ikigo
giteganya mu gihe kizaza n’ingaruka
zishoboka z’ihindagurika ry’ijanisha
ry’inyungu, ibibazo byerekeye ibura
ry’amafaranga n’imari shingiro
ihagije;
(f) gushyiraho ingamba zo kugabanya
ibyateza ingorane;
(g) gusesengura niba hakenewe gukoresha
serivisi z’imari zitangwa hakoreshejwe
ikoranabuhanga n’ingorane zaterwa no
kuzikoresha;
(h) gusohoza indi nshingano yose ikubiye
mu mabwiriza agenga inama
y’ubutegetsi.

articles.heading: Imiterere y’imiyoborere y’ikigo (1) Isosiyete y’imari iciriritse yakira amafaranga abitswa igomba kuba
articles.text:
igizwe n’inzego z’imirimo n’abakozi
hakurikijwe ingano y’ikigo n’urwego
rwacyo rw’imikorere.
(2) Isosiyete y’imari icirirtse yakira
amafaranga abitswa igomba kugira
nibura imirimo ikurikira:
(a) urwego rw’umurimo rushinzwe
ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi;
(b) urwego rw’umurimo rushinzwe
ibikorwa;
(c) urwego rw’umurimo rushinzwe
ibaruramari n’imari;
(d) urwego rw’umurimo rushinzwe
inguzanyo;
(e) urwego rw’umurimo rushinzwe
ubugenzuzi bw’imbere mu kigo;
(f) urwego rw’umurimo rushinzwe
ikoranabuhanga;
(g) urwego rw’umurimo rushinzwe
gucunga ibyateza ingorane
n’iyubahiriza ry’amategeko.

articles.heading: Ubumenyi n’ubushobozi bisabwa abari mu buyobozi bw’ikigo (1) Abakozi b’isosiyete y’imari iciriritse
articles.text:
yakira amafaranga abitswa bagomba
kuba bafite ubumenyi n’ubushobozi
bikenewe mu gucunga ikigo kandi
bagomba gutegurirwa gahunda ihoraho
igamije kubaka ubushobozi bwabo mu
byerekeye imirimo bakora
n’inshingano bafite.
(2) Abakozi bakuriye inzego z’imirimo
zishinzwe inguzanyo, ibikorwa,
ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi, ibaruramari,
imari, ubugenzuzi bw’imbere mu kigo.
Gucunga ibyateza ingorane no
kubahiriza amategeko n’izindi nzego
z’imirimo bagomba nibura kuba bafite
impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya mbere
cya kaminuza mu icungamutungo,
imari, ibaruramari, imirimo
y’amabanki, ubukungu n’ibindi
bifitanye isano.
(3) Abakozi bakuriye inzego z’imirimo
zishinzwe ikoranabuhanga, ibyerekeye
amategeko n’izindi nzego z’imirimo
zisaba ubumenyi bwihariye bagomba
nibura kuba bafite impamyabumenyi
y’icyiciro cya mbere cya kaminuza mu
byo bazobereyemo.
(4) Banki Nkuru ikoresheje amabwiriza
ishobora kugena impamyabumenyi
yihariye ku mukozi ugomba gushyirwa
mu myanya y’imirimo ivugwa mu
ngingo ya 15 n’iya 17 z’aya mabwiriza
rusange.

articles.heading: Ubumenyi n’uburambe bisabwa umuyobozi mukuru Umuyobozi mukuru agomba kuba afite ubumenyi n’impamyabushobozi bikurikira
articles.text:
(a) nibura impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro
cya mbere mu ibaruramari, imari,
imirimo y’amabanki, ubukungu,
ubwoyobozi bw’ubucurizi, amategeko
y’ubucuruzi cyangwa ibindi bifitanye
isano;
(b) nibura uburambe bw’imyaka itanu
muriyo itatu ari mu mwanya
w’ubuyobozi mu byerekeye
ibaruramari, imari, imirimo
y’amabanki, ubukungu cyangwa ibindi
bifitanye isano.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’ubuyobozi Ubuyobozi bw’ikigo bufite inshingano zikurikira
Komite za koperative y’imari iciriritse yakira amafaranga abitswa Bitabangamiye ibiteganyijwe mu itegeko
articles.text:
rigenga amakoperative, koperative y’imari
iciriritse yakira amafaranga abitswa igomba
nibura kuba ifite komite zikurikira zatowe
n’Inteko Rusange:
(a) Inama y’ubutegetsi;
(b) Inama y’ubugenzuzi;
(c) Indi komite yihariye yagenwa na
politiki n’amabwiriza byubahirizwa
mu kigo.

articles.heading: Abagize inama y’ubutegetsi, ubumenyi basabwa n’isuzumamikorere ryabo (1) Inama y’ubutegetsi igizwe nibura
articles.text:
n’abantu barindwi muri bo nibura
kimwe cya gatatu bagomba kuba ari
abari mu nama y’ubutegetsi bigenga.
(2) Abagize inama y’ubutegetsi bose muri
koperative y’imari iciriritse yakira
amafaranga abitswa bagomba kuba
bararangije amashuri yisumbuye
cyangwa ayo bihwanye, bafite
ubumenyi bunyuranye mu masomo
afitanye isano n’ubucuruzi, amategeko,
ikoranabuhanga, amajyambere
y’icyaro n’ubundi bumenyi bifitanye
isano.
(3) Nibura babiri mu bagize inama
y’ubutegetsi bagomba kuba abafite
impamyabumenyi mu ibaruramari
cyangwa andi masomo bifitanye isano.
(4) Koperative y’imari iciriritse yakira
amafaranga abitswa igomba
guteganyiriza amahugurwa ya
ngombwa ahoraho abagize inama
y’ubutegetsi mu gihe kitarenze amezi
atatu nyuma y’uko batangiye
inshingano zabo.
(5) Inama y’ubutegetsi isuzuma buri gihe
ubumenyi ifite bwuzuzanya ndetse
n’uburambe n’ubundi bumenyi
isesengura niba inama y’ubutegetsi
ikora neza.
(6) Iryo suzuma rikorwa n’abagize inama
y’ubutegetsi buri wese asuzuma
mugenzi we kandi n’inama
y’ubutegetsi yisuzuma muri rusange,
cyangwa isuzuma komite n’uruhare
rwa buri wese mu bayigize, na perezida
wayo arimo, hifashishijwe urugero ruri
mu mugereka wa 1 w’aya mabwiriza
rusange.
(7) Isuzuma rikorwa buri mwaka kandi
raporo y’umwaka ikagaragaza ko
byakozwe. Bitarenze itariki ya 30 Mata
y’umwaka ukurikira, Perezida
w’Inama y’Ubutegetsi ashyikiriza
Banki Nkuru raporo irimo ibyavuye
mu isuzuma buri muyobozi yakoreye
mugenzi we n’iryo inama y’ubutegetsi
yikoreye buri mwaka ku mikorere
n’umusaruro y’inama y’ubutegetsi
n’abayigize.

articles.heading: Amatora y’abari mu nama y’ubutegetsi bigenga (1) Inteko rusange ishyiraho komite idahoraho ifite inshingano yo gushaka
articles.text:
abazajya mu nama y’ubutegetsi
bigenga.
(2) Komite idahoraho igizwe n'abantu
batari mu bagize inama y'ubutegetsi
n'inama y'ubugenzuzi.
A
(3) Iyo komite ishyikiriza inteko rusange
imyirondoro y’abakandida byibuze
batatu batorwamo abari mu nama
y’ubutegetsi bigenga hubahirijwe
umubare w’abari mu nama
y’ubutegetsi bigenga bagomba kuba
mu nama y’ubutegetsi.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’inama y’ubutegetsi Inama y’ubutegetsi ifite inshingano zikurikira
Komite z’inama y’ubutegetsi abazigize n’inshingano zazo (1) Inama y’ubutegetsi ya koperative
articles.text:
y’imari iciriritse yakira amafaranga
abitswa igomba kugira nibura komite
zikurikira:
(a) Komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi
ishinzwe inguzanyo;
(b) Komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi
ishinzwe gucunga ibyateza
ingorane;
(c) Indi komite y’inama
y’ubutegetsi yagenwa na
politiki n’amabwiriza
bikurikizwa mu kigo cyangwa
nk’uko byategekwa na Banki
Nkuru.
(2) Komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
inguzanyo igizwe n’ibura n’abantu
batatu.
(3) Komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
gucunga ibyateza ingorane igizwe
nibura n’abantu batatu kandi umwe
muri bo agomba kuba yigenga ndetse
akaba ari we ugomba kuba umuyobozi
w’iyo komite.
(4) Inshingano za komite y’inama
y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe inguzanyo ni
zimwe n’izikubiye mu ngingo ya 12
y’aya mabwiriza rusange.
(5) Inshingano za komite y’inama
y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe gucunga
ibyateza ingorane ni zimwe n’izikubiye
mu ngingo ya 14 y’aya mabwiriza
rusange.
(6) Ibikorwa birebana no gushyira abakozi
mu myanya n’imishahara byigwa
n’inama y’ubutegetsi naho ibikorwa
birebana n’ikoranabuhanga no
gukurikiza amategeko byigwa na
komite y’inama y’ubutegetsi ishinzwe
gucunga ibyateza ingorane.
Igingo ya 24: Inama y’ubugenzuzi
n’ubumenyi abayigize basabwa
(1) Bitabangamiye ibiteganywa n’itegeko
rigenga amakoperative, perezida
w’inama y’ubugenzuzi agomba kuba
ari ugize inama y’ubutegetsi wigenga.
(2) Abagize inama y’ubugenzuzi bose
muri koperative y’imari iciriritse
yakira amafaranga abitswa bagomba
kuba bararangije amashuri yisumbuye
cyangwa ayo bihwanye, bafite
ubumenyi bunyuranye mu masomo
afitanye isano n’ubucuruzi, amategeko,
ikoranabuhanga, amajyambere
y’icyaro n’ubundi bumenyi bifitanye
isano.
(3) Nibura babiri mu bagize komite
y’ubuyobozi bagomba kuba abafite
impamyabumenyi mu ibaruramari
cyangwa andi masomo bifitanye isano.
(4) Koperative y’imari iciriritse yakira
amafaranga abitswa igomba
guteganyiriza amahugurwa ya
ngombwa ahoraho abagize inama
y’ubugenzuzi uhereye mu gihe
kitarenze amezi atatu nyuma y’uko
batangiye inshingano zabo.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’inama y’ubugenzuzi Inama y’ubugenzuzi ifite inshingano z’ibanze zikurikira
articles.text:
(a) Kugenzura ko inyandiko z’imari
zateguriwe igihe kandi mu buryo
bunoze;
(b) Gusuzuma ubugenzuzi bw’imbere mu
kigo harimo ibigize gahunda
y’ubugenzuzi bw’imbere, ibyo
ubugenzuzi bw’imbere bwabashije
kubona no gutanga inama zafatwa
n’ubuyobozi bw’ikigo;
(c) Kugenzura ukuri kw’inyandiko
z’ibaruramari;
(d) Kugenzura gahunda y’itangwa
ry’inguzanyo;
(e) Kugenzura ibikorwa by’andi makomite
harimo inama y’ubutegetsi, komite
ishinzwe inguzanyo n’izindi;
(f) Kugenzura imirimo y’ubuyobozi;
(g) Gukurikirana ko hubahirizwa
amategeko n’amabwiriza rusange;
(h) Gukurikirana ishyira mu bikorwa
ry’ibyemezo by’inama z’inteko
rusange, iz’umugenzuzi w’imbere mu
kigo n’uwigenga, iz’Inama
y’ubugenzuzi ubwayo, Banki Nkuru
n’abandi;
(i) Gukurikirana ishyira mu bikorwa
ry’igenamigambi n’ingengo y’imari;
(j) Gusuzuma raporo z’ubugenzuzi
bw’imbere mu kigo n’umusaruro
wazo, ibyo zavuzeho n’ubucukumbure
bwazo, raporo ku bugenzuzi
bw’imbere n’inama zikubiyemo no
kwemeza niba harakozwe ibikwiriye;
(k) Gusuzuma niba hari imikoranire hagati
y’ubugenzuzi bw’imbere mu kigo
n’abagenzuzi bigenga;
(l) Gukurikirana no gusesengura
ubwisanzure bw’abagenzuzi bigenga,
nibura buri mwaka, hitabwa ku
bisabwa n’umwuga bakora ndetse
n’amabwiriza abagenga;
(m)Gusuzuma hamwe n’abagenzuzi
bigenga gahunda y’ubugenzuzi yabo
n’ibizakorwa, uburyo raporo
z’ubugenzuzi bw’imbere zikorwamo,
ubufasha bwatanzwe n’ubuyobozi
n’abakozi ku bagenzuzi
n’ibyabuvuyemo n’ingamba zikwiriye
gufatwa;
(n) Gusuzuma raporo z’ubuyobozi
n’iz’abagenzuzi bigenga cyane cyane
izerekeye ibinyuranyo n’imikorere
itanoze mu baruramari n’ubugenzuzi
bw’imikorere;
(o) Gusuzuma gahunda y’ubugenzuzi
y’ikigo hagendewe by’umwihariko ku
mabwiriza yerekana ingorane zaturuka
ku kutubahiriza amategeko no
gukumira ingaruka byatera ikigo,
harimo gusuzuma amabaruwa y’inzego
z’ubugenzuzi n’ibisubizo ubuyobozi
bwatanze;
(p) Gukurikirana imyitwarire myiza
y’ikigo no kwiga uburyo yatezwa
imbere, harimo imikoreshereze myiza
y’amabwiriza mu gukemura no
kumenyekanisha ibirego byatanzwe;
(q) Gusuzuma ibikorwa byose
by’ubucuruzi n’abantu bafitanye isano
na koperative y’imari iciriritse yakira
amafaranga abitswa.

articles.heading: Manda (1) Manda muri koperative y’imari iciriritse yakira amafaranga abitswa zigenwa n’itegeko rigenga
articles.text:
amakoperative.
(2) Aho itegeko rigenga amakoperative
ritagize icyo ribivugaho, abagize
komite bagira manda y’imyaka itatu
ishobora kongerwa incuro imwe.
(3) Nta munyamuryango nyuma yo gukora
manda ebyiri zikurikirana wemerewe
gutorwa mu rundi rwego rwose kugeza
hashize imyaka itanu.

articles.heading: Ubunyamuryango bw’abayobozi n’abakozi Abayobozi bose n’abakozi ba koperative y’imari iciriritse yakira amafaranga abitswa
articles.text:
bagomba kuba abanyamuryango b’ikigo
bakoramo nyuma yo guhabwa akazi.

articles.heading: Imiterere y’inzego z’imirimo (1) Imiterere y’inzego z’imirimo z’abakozi ba koperative y’imari
articles.text:
iciriritse yakira amafaranga abitswa
ishingira ku ngano n’urwego rwacyo
rw’imikorere.
(2) Koperative y’imari iciriritse yakira
amafaranga abitswa igomba nibura
kugira inzego z’imirimo zikurikira:
(a) Urwego rw’umurimo
rushinzwe ibikorwa;
(b) Urwego rw’umurimo
rushinzwe imari n’ibaruramari;
(c) Urwego rw’umurimo
rushinzwe ikoranabuhanga;
(d) Urwego rw’umurimo
rushinzwe inguzanyo;
(e) Urwego rw’umurimo
rushinzwe ubugenzuzi
bw’imbere;
A
(f) Urwego rwo gucunga ibyateza
ingorane no kubahiriza
amategeko.

articles.heading: Ubumenyi n’amashuri abakozi bagomba kuba bafite (1) Abakozi ba koperative y’imari icirirtse
articles.text:
yakira amafaranga abitswa bagomba
kuba bafite amashuri n’ubumenyi bya
ngombwa kugira ngo bacunge ikigo
kandi bagenerwa gahunda ihoraho yo
kubaka ubushobozi bwabo mu
byerekeye imirimo n’inshingano zabo.
(2) Abakozi bakora mu mirimo yerekeye
inguzanyo, ibikorwa, ibaruramari,
imari, ubugenzuzi bw’imbere mu kigo,
gucunga ibyateza ingorane n’indi
mirimo ifitanye isano n’ubucuruzi
bagomba kuba bafite
impamyabumenyi mu icungamutungo,
imari, ibaruramari, imirimo
y’amabanki, ubukungu n’ibindi
bifitanye isano.
(3) Abakozi bakora mu mirimo
y’ikoranabuhanga, amategeko
cyangwa indi mirimo isaba ubumenyi
bwihariye bagomba kuba bafite
impamyabumenyi mu nzego z’ibyo
bazobereyemo. Iyo ari ukuriye urwego
rw’umurimo, agomba kuba afite
impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya mbere
cya kaminuza cyangwa iyisumbuyeho.
(4) Ubundi burambe n’impamyabumenyi
zindi bisobanurwa muri politiki
n’amabwiriza bigenga koperative
y’imari icirirtse yakira amafaranga
abitswa.

articles.heading: Ubumenyi umuyobozi mukuru agomba kuba afite Umuyobozi mukuru wa koperative y’imari iciriritse yakira amafaranga abitswa agomba
articles.text:
kuba bafite ubumenyi kandi ujuje
ibyangombwa bikurikira:
(a) nibura impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro
cya mbere cya kaminuza mu
ibaruramari, imari, ubukungu,
ubwoyobozi bw’ubucurizi, amategeko
y’ubucuruzi n’ibindi bifitanye isano;
(b) uburambe nibura bw’imyaka itatu mu
ibaruramari, imari, ubugenzuzi,
imirimo y’amabanki cyangwa ibindi
bifitanye isano.
Icyiciro cya 3: Ingingo zihuriweho
n’amasosiyete n’amakoperative y’imari
iciriritse yakira amafaranga abitswa

articles.heading: Kwemeza abagize inama y’ubutegetsi, abagize inama y’ubugenzuzi n’abagize ubuyobozi (1) Ikigo cy’imari iciriritse cyakira
articles.text:
amafaranga abitswa kigomba gusaba
Banki Nkuru kwemererwa kw’ugize
inama y’ubutegetsi, ugize inama
y’ubugenzuzi n’ugize ubuyobozi
kugira ngo harebwe ko bujuje ibisabwa
bijyanye n’ubunyangamugayo
n’ubushobozi.
(2) Ubusabe bwo kwemererwa
bushyikirizwa Banki Nkuru mu gihe
cy’iminsi 30 nyuma y’uko ashyirwaho
cyangwa atorwa n’urwego rubifitiye
ububasha.
(3) Ubusabe buherekezwa n’ifishi
y’imenyekanisha yuzuzwa n’umuntu
ku giti cye yujujwe neza, iteganyijwe
ku mugereka wa 3 w’amabwiriza
rusange yerekeye ibigenderwaho
n’izindi ngingo zikurikiwa mu
kwemerera ibigo by’imari iciriritse
byakira amafaranga abitswa.
(4) Ikigo cy’imari iciriritse cyakira
amafaranga abitswa kigomba
kumenyesha mu buryo bweruye ugize
inama y’ubutegetsi, ugize inama
y’ubugenzuzi n’ugize ubuyobozi ko
kwemezwa burundu bizakurikiza
icyemezo cya Banki Nkuru.
(5) Ibiteganyijwe mu bika bibanziriza iki
bikurikizwa no ku ugize inama
y’ubutegetsi n’ugize inama
y’ubugenzuzi bongeye gutorwa ndetse
n’ugize ubuyobozi wazamuwe mu
ntera.

articles.heading: Gusuzuma ubunyangamugayo, ubushobozi n’ubunyamwuga by’abakozi Ikigo cy’imari iciriritse cyakira amafaranga
articles.text:
abitswa kigomba kubahiriza ko abakozi
bahawe umurimo bujuje ibisabwa mu
byerekeye ubunyangamugayo, ubushobozi
n’ubunyamwuga nk’uko bikubiye mu
mabwiriza ya Banki Nkuru.

articles.heading: Ihagarikwa n’ihanwaho ry’ugize inama y’ubutegetsi, ugize inama y’ubugenzuzi n’ugize ubuyobozi
articles.text:
(1) Igihe icyo ari cyo cyose mu gihe akiri
mu mwanya mu kigo cy’imari iciriritse
cyakira amafaranga abitswa, Banki
Nkuru ifite uburenganzira bwo
guhagarika ugize inama y’ubutegetsi,
ugize inama y’ubugenzuzi n’ugize
ubuyobozi iyo hari amakuru mabi
atahuwe nyuma cyangwa se mu gihe
akora mu buryo bunyuranyije
n’amategeko n’amabwiriza rusange
bireba, cyangwa se mu gihe ibikorwa
bye bibangamira cyangwa bitari mu
nyungu z’ababitsa n’abaturage muri
rusange.
(2) Ku bw’iyo mpamvu, Banki Nkuru
ishobora gusaba ivanwaho ry’ugize
ubuyobozi mukuru nk’uwo ndetse
n’umusimbura we cyangwa igafata
ibyemezo biteganyijwe mu Itegeko.

articles.heading: Urwego rw’umurimo zigenga (1) Urwego rw’umurimo rushinzwe ubugenzuzi bw’imbere, urwo gucunga
articles.text:
ibyateza ingorane n’urwo kubahiriza
amategeko mu zigomba gukora mu
bwigenge kandi zigatanga raporo mu
buryo bw’imikorere ku mirimo rukora
ku nama y’ubutegetsi no mu buryo
bw’imiyoborere ku muyobozi mukuru.
(2) Ukuriye urwego rw’umurimo
rushinzwe ubugenzuzi bw’imbere mu
kigo agomba gushyikiriza Banki Nkuru
buri gihembwe incamake ya raporo
yakoze ku bugenzuzi bw’imbere mu
kigo mu minsi 20 ikurikira irangira
ry’igihembwe.
A
(3) Mu gihe ukuriye urwego rw’umurimo
rushinzwe ubugenzuzi bw’imbere mu
kigo atahuye imikorere itanoze
ishobora gushyira mu kaga imirimo ya
koperative y’imari iciriritse yakira
amafaranga abitswa, agomba
kubimenyesha Banki Nkuru mu minsi
itanu nyuma yo kubitahura.

articles.heading: Imenyekanisha ry’inyungu rikorwa n’ugize inama y’ubutegetsi Mu mezi atatu nyuma yo gushyirwaho
articles.text:
cyangwa gutorwa n’indi mpinduka iyo ariyo
yose yaba nyuma ku birebana n’umwanya
ashinzwe, ugize inama y’ubutegetsi y’ikigo
cy’imari iciriritse cyakira amafaranga abitswa
amenyesha inama y’ubutegetsi mu ndahiro
yanditse inyungu zose afite mu kigo, isosiyete
cyangwa ishyirahamwe hakurikijwe
imenyekanisha ry’inyungu riri ku mugereka
wa 2 w’aya mabwiriza rusange.

articles.heading: Ibyemezo byerekeye abagize inama y’ubutegetsi, abagize ingezo zatowe, ubuyobozi n’abakozi (1) Abagize inama y’ubutegetsi, abagize
articles.text:
inzego zatowe, ubuyobozi n’abakozi
ntibagomba kugira uruhare mu
cyemezo cyerekeye inyungu zabo
cyangwa inyungu z’abo bafitanye
isano.
(2) Ugize inama y’ubutegetsi, ugize
urwego rwatowe, uri mu buyobozi
cyangwa umukozi ava mu nama ifata
icyemezo cyerekeye inyungu ze
cyangwa inyungu z’uwo bafitanye
isano.

articles.heading: Inguzanyo zahawe abagize inama y’ubutegetsi, abagize ingezo zatowe, abari mu buyobozi n’abakozi
articles.text:
(1) Abagize inama y’ubutegetsi, abagize
inzego zatowe, abari mu buyobozi
n’abakozi b’ikigo cy’imari iciriritse
cyakira amafaranga abitswa bagomba
kwirukanwa ku myanya yabo
y’ubuyobozi igihe bamaze kugira
ubukererwe mu kwishyura inguzanyo
bugera ku minsi 90.
(2) Kwirukanwa bikorwa ako kanya iyo
batishyuye, kandi igihe cyo kwishyura
kigeze ku nguzanyo y’igihe kigufi
n’indi nguzanyo itarishyuwe igejeje
igihe cyo kwishyurwa.
(3) Igihe ubuyobozi bw’ikigo bwongerera
abo bantu ntikivanaho ubukererwe
cyangwa se ibihano byateganijwe.

articles.heading: Serivisi zihabwa abagize inama y’ubutegetsi, inama y’ubugenzuzi, ubuyobozi n’abakozi (1) Buri kigo cy’imari iciriritse yakira
articles.text:
amafaranga abitswa igomba, muri
serivisi iha abagize inama y’ubutegetsi,
abagize inama y’ubugenzuzi
n’iy’ubuyobozi n’abakozi n’abandi
bafitanye isano na yo, kubaha izo
serivisi hakurikijwe ibisabwa
byubahirizwa no ku wundi
munyamuryango cyangwa umukiliya
uwo ariwe wese, keretse biteganijwe
ukundi muri aya mabwiriza rusange.
(2) Igika kivuzwe haruguru ntikiraba
ibipimo by’inyungu zihariye zahabwa
abari mu buyobozi n’abakozi b’ikigo
cy’imari cyakira amafaranga abitswa
mu gihe gifite gahunda y’inguzanyo
zihariye giha abakozi bacyo.

articles.heading: Kubahiriza ibiteganywa n’amategeko (1) Ugize inama y’ubutegetsi, uri mu buyobozi cyangwa umukozi w’ikigo
articles.text:
cy’imari iciriritse cyakira amafaranga
abitswa, mu gusohoza inshingano
zabo, bakora bakurikije ibiteganywa
n’amategeko n’amabwiriza bigenga
ikigo babereye abayobozi cyangwa
abakozi.
(2) Abagize inama y’ubutegetsi, abari mu
buyobozi n’abakozi bakorana
ubwitonzi, kudahubuka, umurava,
kubaha amategeko
n’ubunyangamugayo mu nyungu
z’ikigo babereye abayobozi cyangwa
abakozi.
(3) Ku bw’izo mpamvu, abagize inama
y’ubutegetsi, abagize ubuyobozi
n’abakozi bagomba kwirinda
kwishyira ubwabo mu bihe bituma
inyungu zabo zigongana n’iz’ikigo.

articles.heading: Uruhare mu byemezo Ugize inama y’ubutegetsi, uri mu buyobozi cyangwa umukozi w’ikigo cy’imari iciriritse
articles.text:
cyakira amafaranga abitswa ntagomba gufata
icyemezo cyangwa kugira uruhare mu gufata
icyemezo ku nguzanyo ye bwite cyangwa ku
inyungu ye ndetse n’uwo bafitanye isano
itaziguye cyangwa iziguye kugeza ku gisanira
cya kabiri.

articles.heading: Uburyozwe ku bihombo Abagize inama y’ubutegetsi, abagize ubuyobozi n’abakozi b’ikigo cy’imari iciriritse
articles.text:
cyakira amafaranga abitswa baryozwa, umwe
ku giti cye cyangwa bose, ibihombo biturutse
ku ishoramari, gutanga inguzanyo no kwakira
ubwizigame binyuranyije n’ibiteganyijwe
n’amategeko n’amabwiriza cyangwa politiki
bigenga ikigo cy’imari iciriritse cyakira
amafaranga abitswa.

articles.heading: Ishyirwaho ry’amahame ngenderwaho n’uko akurikizwa (1) Inama y’ubutegetsi ishyiraho politique
articles.text:
yemewe isobanura amahame
ngenderwaho n’amahame agenga
imyitwarire mu bikorwa by’ubucuruzi
bw’ikigo cy’imari iciriritse cyakira
amafaranga abitswa na politiki
ziboneye kugira ngo byubahirizwe.
(2) Amabwiriza ngengamikorere agomba
gukurikizwa ku bagize inama
y’ubutegetsi, abagize inama
y’ubugenzuzi ndetse no ku bagize
ubuyobozi n’abakozi bose muri
rusange.
UMUTWE WA III: INGINGO
ZINYURANYE N’ISOZA

articles.heading: Amakuru ku bunyangamugayo n’ ubushobozi (1) Ikigo cy’imari iciririte cyakira amafaranga abitswa kigomba
articles.text:
kumenyesha Banki Nkuru
umwirondoro wuzuye w’ugize inama
y’ubutegetsi, ugize mu nama
y’ubugenzuzi, uri mu buyobozi
cyangwa umukozi uwo ari we wese
wakoze inyerezamutungo, ubujura,
gucunga umutungo nabi, imikorere
itari kinyamwuga, amakosa mu rwego
rw’akazi n’ibindi byaha cyangwa
wagaragaje imiyoborere idahwitse
cyangwa ubushobozi buke mu kigo
akorera bituma ubunyangamugayo,
ubushobozi n’ubunyamwuga bye
bikemangwa.
(2) Gutanga urutonde n’inyandiko
zisobanura ibyakozwe ku bantu
bavuzwe mu gika cya (1) bikorwa mu
gihe cy’iminsi 30 nyuma yo kwemeza
ko ikosa ryakozwe cyangwa gutanga
igihano ku ikosa bikozwe n’ikigo
cy’imari iciriritse cyakira amafaranga
abitswa.
(3) Banki Nkuru ishyiraho urutonde
rugendanye n’igihe rw’abantu
batemerewe gukora imirimo mu bigo
by’imari.

articles.heading: Ihanagurabusembwa (1) Umuntu wese wirukanywe na Banki Nkuru cyangwa ikigo cy’imari iciriritse cyakira amafaranga abitswa
articles.text:
kubera gukora ikosa mu rwego
rw’imari ku buryo aba atacyujuje
ibisabwa ku bunyangamugayo,
ubushobozi n’ubunyamwuga ashobora
guhanagurwaho ubusembwa na Banki
Nkuru nyuma y’imyaka itanu ibarwa
